title: Finger scan
creator: panumas nikhomkhai
attribution_text: Photo: Finger scan by panumas nikhomkhai on Pexels (Pexels License; credit optional)
description: Hand pressing a finger on a wall-mounted biometric fingerprint terminal with keypad and green scan light.
why_relevant: Shows the physical punch-in/out point that replaces paper attendance registers; staff identity is verified and the punch is logged digitally.
caution: Generic hardware, not a G2G device. Original is 6016x4016; file is a 1600px rendition (kept under 2.5 MB).

title: Modern Fingerprint Access Control System
creator: panumas nikhomkhai
attribution_text: Photo: Modern Fingerprint Access Control System by panumas nikhomkhai on Pexels (Pexels License; credit optional)
description: Wall-mounted fingerprint and keypad terminal whose display shows the current time (12:31).
why_relevant: Time-stamped biometric terminal illustrates automatic capture of in/out times for attendance.
caution: Terminal is shown as access control; present as 'illustrative hardware'. Foreign-language text on screen is not legible.

title: Maternity Leave Marked On Calendar
creator: CIPHR Connect
attribution_text: "Maternity Leave Marked On Calendar" by CIPHR Connect, licensed under CC BY 2.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0), via Wikimedia Commons
description: Flat illustration of a large wall calendar headed MATERNITY LEAVE with a date circled and a woman holding a baby beside it.
why_relevant: Visualises a leave calendar with specific dates marked for an approved leave type, which is the core of the Leave module.
caution: Commons page credits CIPHR Connect (a UK HR software vendor) as author; the image itself carries no logo. Attribution line must be printed. Illustration is maternity-specific; pair with caption about all leave types.

title: A Person Writing on Calendar
creator: RDNE Stock project
attribution_text: Photo: A Person Writing on Calendar by RDNE Stock project on Pexels (Pexels License; credit optional)
description: Office worker marking a date on a large paper monthly planner at a desk with a computer.
why_relevant: The manual paper-calendar way of tracking staff absence, i.e. the 'before' picture the leave module replaces.
caution: Faint monitor brand mark in the corner is not legible; person's face is not shown.

title: Payroll documents and calendar arranged on table with pencils
creator: Monstera Production
attribution_text: Illustration: Payroll documents and calendar arranged on table with pencils by Monstera Production on Pexels (Pexels License; credit optional)
description: Flat vector-style illustration of a sheet headed PAYROLL with ruled lines, a desk calendar and pencils on a tan background.
why_relevant: Clean, generic payroll-sheet-plus-calendar graphic that conveys periodic payroll processing without any third-party branding.
caution: Abstract; does not show a real payslip layout or salary structure. Original is 8000x4500; file is a 1600px rendition. No backup image for payroll passed licence/relevance checks.

title: Candidate having an Interview
creator: Tima Miroshnichenko
attribution_text: Photo: Candidate having an Interview by Tima Miroshnichenko on Pexels (Pexels License; credit optional)
description: Candidate seated across a table from an interviewer with a laptop showing a CV, notebook and clipboard in a bright office.
why_relevant: Depicts the interview/selection stage of the recruitment pipeline where candidate records and CVs are reviewed.
caution: Staged stock photo with identifiable models; laptop shows MacBook Pro model text (no logo prominent). Covers recruitment only, not whole talent suite.

title: People Standing Beside a Whiteboard
creator: RDNE Stock project
attribution_text: Photo: People Standing Beside a Whiteboard by RDNE Stock project on Pexels (Pexels License; credit optional)
description: Four colleagues posing beside a whiteboard reading NEW HIRE in an open-plan office.
why_relevant: Illustrates onboarding: welcoming a new hire into the team after selection.
caution: Staged stock photo with identifiable models; small monitor brand marks not legible.

title: Diverse Team Engaged in Business Training Workshop
creator: Beniam
attribution_text: Photo: Diverse Team Engaged in Business Training Workshop by Beniam on Pexels (Pexels License; credit optional)
description: Staff seated at tables with laptops and notebooks during a classroom training session with presentation screens behind.
why_relevant: Shows employees in structured training, the activity the Learning module schedules, delivers and records.
caution: Portrait orientation (1600x2000); screens are blurred and unreadable; no certificate or e-learning UI shown.

title: Online Class in a Laptop
creator: cottonbro studio
attribution_text: Photo: Online Class in a Laptop by cottonbro studio on Pexels (Pexels License; credit optional)
description: Laptop on a wooden desk showing a video class with an instructor and a learner, notebooks beside it.
why_relevant: Represents remote/online course delivery for staff e-learning.
caution: Instructor shown with a children's-shapes chart, so context is school-like; use caption 'online learning'. Laptop brand not legible.
